bagPolicy.summary: Bags may not be larger than 21 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm (A4 format). Luggage, large handbags and backpacks are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 21 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm (A4)
bagPolicy.note: Foyer lockers cost 8 euros (medium) or 11 euros (large). Bigger lockers at the bike parking on car park Vaart, right of the Sportpaleis, cost 11 or 15 euros.

parking.summary: Use free Park & Ride lots outside the city with tram connections, or paid parking closer to the dome.
